size_construction_rule: Append exactly target_utf8_bytes minus UTF-8 prefix byte length spaces. Store actual bytes/count/hash in execution evidence. No normalization or serializer rewriting after sizing.

fault_variants.F-DEFINITE-503: Intercept before forwarding; exact E-STORAGE; zero forwarded POST; unchanged snapshot.
fault_variants.F-INTERNAL-PRE: Forward one POST; controlled failure before commit; E-INTERNAL; unchanged snapshot.
fault_variants.F-INTERNAL-POST: Forward one POST; commit proved; E-INTERNAL after commit; one new tuple.
fault_variants.F-DROP-PRE: Drop before forwarding; transport error; unchanged snapshot, yet UI must reconcile.
fault_variants.F-DROP-POST: One forwarded POST and proven commit; drop response; one new tuple, UI must reconcile.
fault_variants.F-CREATE-REFRESH-FAIL: Forward one POST, deliver 201, fail following GET; one new tuple and no resend.
fault_variants.F-RECONCILE-FAIL: Apply each ambiguous variant, fail first reconciliation GET, then permit deliberate GET; no extra POST until deliberate create after successful refresh.

future_method_requirement: TC must provide independently reviewed isolation, fixture install, snapshot, interception/fault causality and cleanup methods. Impossible/unproved injection => UNAVAILABLE, not simulated application PASS.
browser_input_spec: browser-input.md; each browser_input is an additional predetermined oracle, never a replacement for the literal API case.
